default_target.cmd: (if grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*entry[[:space:]]*=' geisha.toml || [ -f src/main.gsa ]; then geisha check; fi) && geisha test

parsec.gsa.cmd: geisha check && geisha doc parsec >/dev/null && geisha test

regex.gsa.cmd: geisha check && geisha doc regex >/dev/null && geisha test && geisha --src-root src --target js -o /tmp/regex_spec.mjs tests/spec.gsa && node /tmp/regex_spec.mjs && geisha --src-root src --target wasm32 --opt z --strip -o /tmp/regex_spec.wasm tests/spec.gsa && test -s /tmp/regex_spec.wasm

datetime.gsa.cmd: geisha check && geisha doc datetime >/dev/null && geisha test && geisha --src-root src --target js -o /tmp/datetime_spec.mjs tests/spec.gsa && node /tmp/datetime_spec.mjs

crypto.gsa.cmd: geisha check && geisha doc crypto >/dev/null && geisha test && geisha --src-root src --target js -o /tmp/crypto_spec.mjs tests/spec.gsa && node /tmp/crypto_spec.mjs && geisha --src-root src --target wasm32 --opt z --strip -o /tmp/crypto_spec.wasm tests/spec.gsa && test -s /tmp/crypto_spec.wasm

starter.gsa.cmd: python3 -c 'import os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile; root = pathlib.Path.cwd(); cli = [sys.executable, str(root / "bin" / "geisha-starter")]; td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(); tmp = pathlib.Path(td.name); [subprocess.run(cli + ["--template-repo", str(root), "-t", t, str(tmp / f"demo_{t}")], check=True) for t in ("cli", "lib", "wasm", "web-js")]; [subprocess.run(["geisha", "check"], cwd=tmp / f"demo_{t}", check=True) for t in ("cli", "lib", "wasm", "web-js")]; [subprocess.run(["geisha", "test"], cwd=tmp / f"demo_{t}", check=True) for t in ("cli", "lib", "wasm", "web-js")]; assert subprocess.check_output(["geisha", "run", "--", "World"], cwd=tmp / "demo_cli", text=True).strip() == "Hello, World!"; subprocess.run(["geisha", "build", "--target", "wasm32"], cwd=tmp / "demo_wasm", check=True); assert (tmp / "demo_wasm" / "build" / "demo_wasm.wasm").stat().st_size > 0; subprocess.run(["geisha", "build", "--target", "js"], cwd=tmp / "demo_web-js", check=True); assert (tmp / "demo_web-js" / "build" / "demo_web_js.mjs").stat().st_size > 0; td.cleanup()'

plot.gsa.cmd: clang -std=c99 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c native/plot_png_software.c -o /tmp/plot_png_sw.o && rm -f /tmp/plot_png_sw.o && geisha check && geisha doc plot.plot >/dev/null && geisha test

targets.label: crema (linux-wasm)
targets.cmd: geisha check && geisha doc crema.ui >/dev/null && geisha test && make wasm && test -s build/studio.wasm

targets.label: crema (macos-native)
targets.cmd: geisha check && geisha doc crema.ui >/dev/null && make test

net.gsa.cmd: geisha doc net.stream >/dev/null && geisha doc net.tls >/dev/null && geisha doc net.ws >/dev/null && geisha doc net.wss >/dev/null && geisha doc net.http >/dev/null && geisha test

tensor.gsa.cmd: geisha check && geisha doc tensor.tensor >/dev/null && geisha doc tensor.ops >/dev/null && geisha test

duckdb.gsa.cmd: geisha check && geisha doc duckdb.duckdb >/dev/null && geisha doc duckdb.dsl >/dev/null && geisha test

tabular.gsa.cmd: geisha check && geisha doc tabular.tabular >/dev/null && geisha doc tabular.frame >/dev/null && geisha test

targets.label: objc.gsa (macos-ios-sim)
targets.cmd: geisha check && geisha doc objc >/dev/null && geisha test && GEISHA_GC_HEAP_WORDS=4096 geisha test
